subject.title: fix(feishu): WebSocket encryptKey SecretRefs are ignored at runtime

question: Should Feishu websocket `encryptKey` SecretRefs fail closed when explicitly configured but unavailable?
rationale: The code fix matches the documented SecretRef surface, but it changes upgrade behavior for users whose websocket config already contains an invalid or unavailable `encryptKey` SecretRef.

options.title: Accept fail-closed activation
options.body: Merge with the explicit understanding that configured websocket `encryptKey` SecretRefs are now active runtime credentials and unresolved refs can stop startup or reload.

options.title: Add upgrade wording first
options.body: Ask for a short PR-body or release-note context line explaining that invalid websocket `encryptKey` SecretRefs are no longer ignored.

options.title: Keep the old ignore behavior
options.body: Reject or pause this PR if maintainers want websocket `encryptKey` SecretRefs to remain inactive unless a separate opt-in is added.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed activation
recommendation.body: Merge with the explicit understanding that configured websocket `encryptKey` SecretRefs are now active runtime credentials and unresolved refs can stop startup or reload.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current Feishu lines and the prior Feishu encrypt-key hardening work, so they are the best available owner for the compatibility call.
